title: OpenStax calls the lexicon a language's words and grammar its rules
summary: OpenStax says the lexicon is a language's vocabulary, and grammar is the set of rules for conveying meaning with those words.
body: In section 7.2, OpenStax says spoken, signed, or written language has a lexicon and a grammar. Lexicon means the words of a given language, its vocabulary. Grammar means the set of rules used to convey meaning through that lexicon. The textbook's example of a rule is that most English verbs take an -ed ending for the past. The section cites Fernandez and Cairns, 2011. This is a definition in the CC BY 4.0 first edition, not a grammar of one language written out in full.
